description: `/` is reserved in a reduction agent id, and the adapter refuses a rune whose name contains one (`adapter-ports`). The reservation is not cosmetic: a spliced agent is named `<rune>/<agent>` (§7), and both `box_path` and the derived-id owner prefix (§2) read structure back out of an id — so a rune literally named `a/b` in a FLAT mantle would otherwise read as an agent belonging to a box called `a`. Refusing the input is the standing preference over guessing at it. This is a flat case with no boxes at all, which is the point: the reservation holds everywhere, not only where composition happens.
